This is a senior software engineering role (6+ years of experience, with at least 4 in Go) at Rancher Government Solutions, working remotely on cloud-native infrastructure for U.S. federal agencies and other regulated environments. The work centers on writing Golang applications and microservices built around Kubernetes extension patterns — controllers, operators, and custom resource definitions — alongside Helm, Kustomize, and GitOps-based infrastructure-as-code. Supporting technologies include Linux, containers, CI/CD pipelines, AWS and Azure government clouds, and some front-end work in Vue.js or Nuxt.
